findings.title: Launch admission precedes any owned durable startup capture
findings.fact: Route parsing, route/seal authentication, bootstrap identity, output mkdir, full inventory and coordinator import can throw before coordinate creates Budget and publishes root-route. The committed README launch command has no outer raw wrapper or redirection. No failure receipt is established around this startup path.
findings.requiredBoundary: Bind concrete independently owned startup stdout/stderr/status capture before fallible launch/admission; include its child, capture, storage, deadline and retirement costs. This is not a request to accept or run a new root route.

findings.title: Outgoing phase deadlines are not checked at phase transition
findings.fact: phase(name) admits only against the incoming phase end. For example, setup can complete after its fixed 600000ms end and phase(build) still admits until 720000ms, without recording setup lateness. Post-child build validation can likewise extend into install's later phase end. These are parent-observed transition conditions, not an observed timed run.
findings.requiredBoundary: Check and retain the outgoing parent-observed deadline before replacing phase authority; late setup, validation and cleanup cannot borrow the following phase's allowance.
